finding_evidence.R21-F1-KNOWN-ABSENT-HASH: The release-active CMake gate invokes the actual null-device standalone and robust master CLI. It checks exact exit codes, a single reconciliation summary, all zero outcome counts and the selection diagnostic. Its 32 rows cover known empty, absent hash in a populated or empty complete archive, required unavailable and malformed inputs with and without a complete companion, optional unavailable and malformed inputs, optional-only with and without a hash, accepted and rejected recovered prefixes, and the combined policy. The clean prior Release/OFF binary passes the existing healthy modes, then fails the new exact summary assertion with discovery complete but selected_total unknown.

summary: Replay determines eligible scope independently of an explicit pipeline hash match. An absent hash in an enumerated scope exits unsuccessfully with a hash-specific diagnostic and exact zero selected. Incomplete required discovery keeps an unknown total and its discovery diagnostic. Accepted recovered prefixes and optional-input exclusions keep their scope labels on rejection.

R21-bounded-state.assertions: 105,000 keys with exact backing-store accounting, deterministic stale/out-of-order duplicates, codec and omission controls, matching distributions with capped warning collection enabled or disabled. Narrow real archive selection checks one stable item, exact owned storage including the worker vector capacity, and zero large preparation allocations still live at the worker fork.

R21-production-ordering.assertions: Real null-device call traces and real controller. Crash at index 10 creates 1..9 and 11..20, retries [11,21), marks 10 skipped and 0 unknown with nonzero status. Dependency crash with borrowed index retries [1,21) without an attributed selected culprit. Paired clean case creates 21 selected and the dependency. Nested replacement attributes actual success and two failure paths at stable selected indices, separate from the borrowed cursor. Controlled failures retain the existing legacy counter.

R21-reconciliation-properties.assertions: 5,040 permutations with four duplicate subsets per permutation, independent terminal oracle, tag/hash/worker/range validation, conflict and stale failure history, and strict codec resynchronization.

R21-regression-sensitivity.assertions: Exact clean control passed. An isolated mutation is an independent checker gate.

R21-retry-and-evidence-loss.assertions: Actual retry ranges and previous terminal failure retained, clean FINAL and native zero require item facts, hard loss/truncation preserves only received facts, full sibling evidence survives either harvest order, setup failure leaves known selection unknown.

R21-selected-boundary-and-outcomes.assertions: Exact per-item creation, read, parse, support, dependency, validation, VkResult and setup outcomes, first-success/later-failure loop, no-execution status, actual compatible hint skip, required incomplete and accepted recovered scope, equal hashes across tags, composite duplicates, extra library role, and ordinary, quiet and progress controller paths. Real standalone and robust master executions assert exact empty scope counts and exit behavior independently of absent requested hash versus unresolved discovery, including optional-only and accepted-prefix scope.
